cases.name: test_provider_live_acceptance_is_not_a_dev_deployment_gate
cases.finding: Still asserts six literal success values; actual complete_success uses success:success:${expected_paper}:success:success:success. Existing no-OpenClaw/provider-gate assertions passed; failure does not show a provider gate.

cases.name: test_deployment_completion_retains_real_checks_without_provider_gate[None-root]
cases.finding: Fixture sets PAPER_BOOTSTRAP_OUTCOME=success but omits PAPER_BOOTSTRAP_REQUESTED. Actual helper defaults expected_paper=skipped unless explicitly requested, so returns false. Source has the applicability field bound at lease_cleanup env.

cases.name: test_deployment_completion_retains_real_checks_without_provider_gate[None-auto]
cases.finding: Same missing applicability input as root case. bff no-failure case supplies skipped and was not in failing list; root/auto are not evidence that the runtime success path is broken.

cases.name: test_all_third_party_actions_are_full_sha_pinned
cases.finding: Fails only hardcoded checkout count6 versus actual7. Static inspection of frozen workflow finds all third-party uses refs full40hex; the existing subsequent per-ref validation is never reached after the obsolete count assertion.

cases.name: test_dev_root_post_up_failure_rolls_back_to_captured_baseline_negative
cases.finding: Old assertion demands unconditional root/auto paper-bootstrap failure predicate. Actual compensation gates paper-bootstrap failure with PAPER_BOOTSTRAP_REQUESTED=true, matching scoped ordinary-code release behavior. Test aborts at string check before its later simulation.

cases.name: test_restart_admission_removal_is_detected
cases.finding: The borrowed root completion fixture has the same missing applicability flag. Even replacing AGORA_OUTCOME by success remains false because unrequested paper success mismatches expected skipped; the negative assertion no longer discriminates restart removal. Actual workflow still folds AGORA_OUTCOME.

cases.name: test_release_case_retirement_runs_after_both_compensation_paths
cases.finding: Expects old accepted-or-compensated Admit cleanup and post-compensation Deploy retirement. Current workflow has candidate-only pre_restore retirement before restore and accepted-only cleanup after exact final verification; old later step-name/outcome assertions are stale too. No runtime rollback failure is demonstrated by this string mismatch.

cases.name: test_release_case_retirement_uses_only_the_retire_action
cases.finding: Demands old saga HTTP /retire literal. Existing helper intentionally composes BFF provisioning owner, gets retire_persona_provisioning_case and calls retire_case for the whole aggregate; no legacy HTTP fallback. Restoring the old URL would contradict the current owner boundary.

audit.root_cause: Workflow/helper contracts changed in their focused tests while this legacy lease-contract file independently encoded literals, old lifecycle ordering and a coupled fixture. Its duplicated assumptions were not updated, and the bad positive fixture also masks the restart negative oracle. These eight are real test-debt findings, not eight proven runtime defects.
audit.action_pin_boundary: The all40hex observation applies ONLY to third-party uses: action implementation SHAs (e.g. actions/checkout@34e...). It says NOTHING about each checkout with.ref repository revision. The independently documented controller with.ref:dev race is a real workflow defect; full-SHA-pinned action code does not pin the repository revision.
